reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows LCO can be enhanced by thermal aging and improves irradiation resistance in CrCoNi, but none of the cited passages address 316L stainless steel, passive film formation, or corrosion resistance. E4 discusses uniform element distribution in a different alloy (CoCrFeMnNi) and its effect on passivation, but does not link this to LCO. The key premises thus lack specific prior evidence.
premises: Thermal aging can induce enhanced local chemical order (LCO) in 316L stainless steel
Enhanced LCO promotes a uniform, Cr-enriched passive oxide film
